_readme: THE permissions table. Pages (privacy, reviewers, support) and scripts/audit-dist.mjs both read it. Edit here and nowhere else. A scope's `used: false` renders a visible 'not used by a shipped feature' note, because the code (not the site) decides what each permission does. Source: reelay/oauth.py PROVIDERS and reelay/youtube.py SCOPES at 9f3a2fb.
_removedNote: Still requested by the app at 9f3a2fb; the owner is removing them before review. The site is written without them, and the audit fails if any appears on a page.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.signIn: Google sign-in in your browser, returning to a one-time loopback address on your Mac (RFC 8252) with PKCE. The code is exchanged on your Mac.

scopes.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload
scopes.purpose: Uploads a video you choose to your channel, with the title, description, tags, visibility and publish time you set, so YouTube publishes it on schedule.
scopes.where: Board → a ticket → Post automatically to → YouTube

scopes.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly
scopes.purpose: Reads your channel and its uploads, including private and scheduled ones: to list them as a download source, to show the channel's latest uploads and schedule, and to confirm when a scheduled video has gone live.
scopes.where: Library → Download Sources (your connected channel) · Accounts → Channel Schedule → Load from YouTube · Board → refresh (Check YouTube for updates)

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.signIn: TikTok sign-in in your browser, returning to a one-time loopback address on your Mac with PKCE. Reelay's sign-in server exchanges the code (TikTok requires the app secret) and returns the tokens to the app.

scopes.name: user.info.basic
scopes.purpose: Shows the connected TikTok account's display name and picture on its card, so you can see which account is attached to which creator profile.

scopes.name: video.list
scopes.purpose: Requested by Reelay's TikTok sign-in. No shipped feature calls TikTok's video list endpoint yet.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.signIn: Instagram sign-in in your browser. Instagram returns to Reelay's sign-in server, which exchanges the code and sends your browser back to the app with a one-time key; the app collects the result once. It is held at most 10 minutes.

scopes.name: instagram_business_basic
scopes.purpose: Identifies the connected Instagram professional account and shows its username on its card. Reelay does not post to Instagram: you post in Instagram, with Prepare to Publish.

platforms.name: Threads
platforms.signIn: Threads sign-in in your browser, through Reelay's sign-in server as for Instagram. Held at most 10 minutes.

scopes.name: threads_basic
scopes.purpose: Identifies the connected Threads account and shows its username on its card. Required by Threads for publishing.

scopes.name: threads_content_publish
scopes.purpose: Publishes the Threads post you wrote on a ticket, with its video, at the time you set. Only once you turn Threads posting on; it's off by default.
scopes.where: Settings → Automatic posting → Threads, then Board → a ticket → Post automatically to → Threads

platforms.name: Facebook Pages
platforms.signIn: Facebook sign-in in your browser, through Reelay's sign-in server as for Instagram. Held at most 10 minutes.

scopes.name: pages_show_list
scopes.purpose: Lists the Facebook Pages you manage, so you can choose which Page Reelay connects.

scopes.name: pages_read_engagement
scopes.purpose: Reads the chosen Page's name and ID to confirm the connection before each post.
scopes.where: Accounts → Facebook card; checked again when a post goes out

scopes.name: pages_manage_posts
scopes.purpose: Publishes or schedules the video post you wrote on a ticket to that Page. Only once you turn Facebook posting on; it's off by default.
scopes.where: Settings → Automatic posting → Facebook, then Board → a ticket → Post automatically to → Facebook
